cell_type: inferred: whereas morphologically normal human lung alveoli are enriched with cytokeratin-7, -8, -18, -19, 14, and -17.
disease_state: The specimens used for this study met the criteria for Idiopathic Pulmonary Fibrosis (IPF) diagnosis
material_type: Human lung samples were formalin-fixed and paraffin-embedded (FFPE).
sample_source: Micro-dissected morphologically normal human lung alveoli (0.082 mm3) and human lung blood vessels (0.094 mm3) from FFPE-fixed H&E-stained sections from Idiopathic Pulmonary Fibrosis (IPF) specimens (n = 3 IPF specimens) were then subject to a qualitative and then quantitative proteomics approach using BayesENproteomics.
species: The use of human lung tissue was approved by University of Manchester Health Research Authority with patient consent under protocol REC#14/NW/0260.
